shortDescription: Get top statistics for a specific type

options.name: api_port
options.description: Port for the Technitium DNS API. Defaults to 5380

options.name: api_token
options.description: API token for authenticating with the Technitium DNS API

options.name: api_url
options.description: Base URL for the Technitium DNS API

options.name: end
options.description: End date in ISO 8601 format. Only applies to 'Custom' type.

options.name: limit
options.description: Maximum number of records to return.

options.name: no_reverse_lookup
options.description: Disable reverse DNS lookup for Top Clients. Only applicable with TopClients stats type.

options.name: node
options.description: The node domain name for which the stats data is needed When unspecified, the current node is used Set node name as 'cluster' to get aggregate stats for the entire cluster This parameter can be used only when Clustering is initialized

options.name: only_rate_limited_clients
options.description: List only clients that are being rate limited. Only applicable with TopClients stats type.

options.name: start
options.description: Start date in ISO 8601 format. Only applies to 'Custom' type.

options.name: stats_type
options.description: The type of statistics to retrieve.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Whether to validate SSL certificates when making API requests.
